summary.name: Google AI Edge Eloquent
summary.one_liner: Free on-device AI dictation and voice editing app from Google that works in any app, currently English only.
summary.what_it_does: Google AI Edge Eloquent is a dictation tool that converts speech to text using on-device AI, according to the listing that references it. It works across any app and includes voice editing of text. The page text provided is mostly feedback widget content and does not describe features in detail. The listing says it is free and currently supports English only.
notable: Runs AI on-device, per the listing
Works in any app, per the listing
